cards.text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, is writing to people who have a faith as precious as his (2 Peter 1:1). He's just told them to keep adding to their faith, from virtue all the way up to love (2 Peter 1:5-7). Now he tells them he'll ALWAYS remind them of these things.

cards.question: Peter says he'll keep reminding these believers because they aren't yet established in the truth.

cards.text: They know it, they're established in the truth, and Peter's STILL gonna remind them. That's the coworker who says "Meeting at three, don't forget," and you go "I KNOW," and then you make that meeting on time because he said it.
Peter thinks it's right to refresh their memory as long as he lives in the tent of his body. Not a house, not a castle, friend, a TENT.

cards.question: Peter calls his body a tent. What does he say will soon happen to that tent?

answers.text: It will be carried far away

cards.question: Peter knows the tent of his body will soon be laid aside. Who made that clear to him?
Peter will make every effort so that after his departure, these believers will be able to ___ these things at all times.

cards.text: Then Peter looks back at when he and the others made known to them the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. He says they weren't following cleverly devised fables.

cards.question: Peter says that he and the others were eyewitnesses of Jesus's majesty.

cards.text: This isn't "my cousin's coworker heard about it," friend. Peter points to when Jesus received honor and glory from God the Father, when a voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory.

cards.question: God the Father gave Jesus honor and glory. What did the voice from the Majestic Glory say about Him?

answers.text: This is My beloved Son in whom I am well pleased
This is My messenger who will prepare the way
This is the Lamb who will take away all sin

cards.question: Peter says he and the others heard that voice from heaven themselves.

cards.text: And they heard it while they were with Jesus, up on the holy mountain. I'd remember a moment like that forever, friend, and I can't even remember where I set my timer.
Peter's got more than what he heard on that holy mountain. He says they also have the word of the prophets, confirmed beyond doubt.

cards.question: Peter tells these believers they can now set the word of the prophets aside.
Peter says they'll do well to pay attention to the word of the prophets. He says it's like paying attention to what?

answers.text: A lamp shining in a dark place
A trumpet sounding over a city
A well of water in a desert

cards.text: Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer, so I KNOW what a little light in the dark is worth. And Peter doesn't just say pay attention to the prophets' word, he says pay attention UNTIL.

cards.question: Peter tells these believers to keep paying attention to the word of the prophets, as to a lamp shining in a dark place. Until when?

answers.text: Until the day dawns and the morning star rises in their hearts
Until the rain falls and the dry fields grow green once more
Until the storm passes and the winds over the sea grow still

cards.text: Then Peter gets to the thing they must understand above all. It's about where prophecy of Scripture comes from.

cards.question: Above all, Peter says no prophecy of Scripture comes from what?
Peter says no prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man.

cards.text: Instead, men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit. And that's good news, friend, because if MY recipes came out of my own head, you'd be eating strawberry-peppermint-raisin surprise.
